facts.anchor: It’s the first Sunday in September, early evening, and the banks of the canal
facts.fact: 九月第一个星期日的傍晚，运河两岸人群拥挤。

facts.anchor: Elisabeth arrived five weeks ago, on the first of August.
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白于八月一日到达，已过去五周。

facts.anchor: Her landlady, Madame Pajot, is the only person here who knows her name
facts.fact: 她的房东是 Madame Pajot，也是这里唯一知道她名字的人。

facts.anchor: her mother texted her that a large envelope had arrived for her from Paris
facts.fact: 五个月前，她的母亲发短信告诉她，有一封来自巴黎的大信封到了。

facts.anchor: Her dad has been dead for three months now
facts.fact: 她的父亲已去世三个月。

facts.anchor: she woke up at 4 a.m. but waited until the decency of six
facts.fact: 星期一早上她 4 点醒来，但等到六点才出门去湖边。

facts.anchor: Seb was only fifty-one, a healthy man, a total shock.
facts.fact: 塞布去世时仅五十一岁，身体健康，事发突然。

facts.anchor: the water is so calm, as though it has no idea what’s coming
facts.fact: 河水在她右侧沿小路流过，水面平静。
